SELECT pay15_remain_leave_days AS remain_leave_days, pay15_add_leave_days AS add_leave_days, pay15_remain_leave_days + pay15_add_leave_days AS total_remain_leave_days, pay15_daily_amt AS daily_amt, (pay15_remain_leave_days + pay15_add_leave_days) * pay15_daily_amt AS retire_leave_amt FROM ( SELECT ty_remain_leave_days + CASE WHEN py_month_leave_days <= py_use_leave_days THEN 0 ELSE py_month_leave_days - py_use_leave_days END AS pay15_remain_leave_days, CASE WHEN calc_std1_leave_days <= calc_std2_leave_days THEN 0 ELSE calc_std1_leave_days - calc_std2_leave_days END AS pay15_add_leave_days, daily_amt AS pay15_daily_amt FROM ( SELECT f_get_leave_days2(#{personId}, #{year}, '3', #{retireDate}, 'true') AS ty_remain_leave_days, f_get_leave_days(#{personId}, CAST(CAST(#{year} AS NUMERIC)-1 AS VARCHAR), '5', null, 'true') AS py_month_leave_days, f_get_leave_days(#{personId}, CAST(CAST(#{year} AS NUMERIC)-1 AS VARCHAR), '2', null, 'true') AS py_use_leave_days, COALESCE(( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay15_leave_days),0) FROM pay15_retire_leave WHERE pay15_month_id = #{monthId} AND pay15_calc_std_type = '1' ),0) AS calc_std1_leave_days, COALESCE(( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay15_leave_days),0) FROM pay15_retire_leave WHERE pay15_month_id = #{monthId} AND pay15_calc_std_type = '2' ),0) AS calc_std2_leave_days, TRUNC(COALESCE((SELECT pay01_annual_pay FROM pay01_annual INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = pay01_appr_id WHERE pay01_person_id = #{personId} AND pay01_start_date <= #{retireDate} AND apr01_status_cd = '30' ORDER BY pay01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1),0) / 12 / 209 * 8) AS daily_amt ) t1 ) t2
